title: Stage 8 manifest
description: Minimal structural schema for docs/organization/gates/stage8-manifest.json (INC-001 §6). Describes the shape actually in use today; not wired into any validator yet — nothing in the repo runs $schema-based validation. Kept intentionally loose (additionalProperties allowed throughout) so it documents structure without becoming a second source of truth that drifts from the manifest's evolving per-entry narrative fields.

stage8.description: Either a filed record (doc/verdict) or an explicit waiver (waived: true), or both. flagEnableApproved is the explicit, positive signal that a reviewer approved enabling a gated flag in a real build — distinct from the mere absence of a waiver.

flagEnableApproved.description: True only when a reviewer has explicitly signed off on enabling the surface's gated flag in a real (non-development) build. Must not be inferred from waived being absent or false.
